segments.he: וְכֵן הַבָּא עַל אַחַת מִכׇּל הָעֲרָיוֹת. אָמַר רַב עַמְרָם: הָא מִלְּתָא אֲמַר לַן רַב שֵׁשֶׁת,
segments.en: § It was taught in the mishna: «And so too, one who had intercourse with any one of those with whom relations are forbidden» by «the Torah» in any form is liable to receive punishment. «Rav Amram said: This matter was said» to us by «Rav Sheshet,»
